blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Wednesday, Nov. 18, reminded motorists that security exclusion zones and other traffic schemes implemented for the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summit remain in effect.
